blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Residents in Cebu should prepare for possible rain showers and localized flooding on Friday, October 30. The trough of a low-pressure area (LPA) brings cloudy skies and scattered rains across the Visayas, according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA). Pagasa Visayas said the weather system could trigger moderate to occasionally heavy rainfall, raising the risk of flash floods and landslides in vulnerable areas. In its regional weather forecast issued on Friday morning, Pagasa said the LPA trough would influence weather conditions across the Visayas, including Cebu, even as the weather disturbance remained unlikely […]...
